chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Do not eat while you are walking, unless you are compelled to do that.

key_terms.تُضْطَرَّ: to be compelled or forced by necessity

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat while walking in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette of eating: one should not eat while walking under normal circumstances. It allows an exception in a case of necessity or compulsion, indicating both refinement in conduct and flexibility in hardship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4247 - Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who reported from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), that he said:
"Do not eat while you are walking unless you are compelled to do so."
